status: provisional. The two-axis model became the primary on 2026-11-09 (Phase 2 decision D1, research/report.md); its values stay provisional.
unit: A color pair: a ground color and a figure color, with an optional small accent. Ground and figure are assigned from visual evidence, never from the order a source lists colors. An Image-Led direction has no ground: it is a type color set on imagery, with a scrim.

neutralChromaCeiling.meaning: A color with OKLCH C at or below this value is neutral. It may be visibly tinted.

vibrant.meaning: A chromatic color is vibrant when it meets both floors. Relative chroma is C divided by the sRGB maximum C at the same L and h.

pastel.meaning: A chromatic color that is very light and gentle. Pastel colors count as muted for primary classification.

lightGround.meaning: The ground is Light when its OKLCH L is at least 0.60, otherwise Dark. Grounds inside the review band get lower confidence. For grays the WCAG black-or-white text crossover sits near L 0.58.
lightGround.midToneNote: Least certain for chromatic grounds. Award chromatic colors peak at L 0.60–0.70, on the boundary, while award neutral grounds avoid L 0.35–0.75 (research/report.md, section 4). The binary is kept (Phase 2 D5); a chromatic ground in the review band gets its own flag.

sameHueFamily.meaning: Two chromatic colors within this many degrees of OKLCH hue belong to one hue family.

multicolorAccentShare.meaning: An accent counts as playing a substantial role only when its declared share of area is at least this value.

twoAxis.description: The primary classification: a foundation value plus a structure value. Saturation is a secondary tag (Vibrant, Muted, Pastel), not part of the primary.

structure.label: Neutral
structure.test: Ground and figure are both neutral.

structure.label: Chromatic
structure.test: Exactly one of ground and figure is chromatic.

structure.label: Monochromatic
structure.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and within one hue family.

structure.label: Two-Tone
structure.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and in different hue families.

structure.label: Multicolor
structure.test: Ground, figure and accent are all chromatic, their hues are pairwise more than one hue family apart, and the accent holds at least the multicolor accent share.
structure.notes: Untestable from award records, which hold at most two colors and no area shares. The Phase 2 review found multicolor sites as imagery or color blocking instead.

structure.label: Image-Led
structure.test: No flat ground: a type color set on imagery, with a scrim. Foundation is null.
structure.notes: A tone-based Image-Led model failed its Phase 2 test against 62 photo-led sites (research/data/analysis/image-led-test.md): imagery tone does not settle Light or Dark. The type-and-scrim model is provisional and unvalidated, so the library holds no Image-Led direction yet.

twoAxis.unresolved: Use Unresolved, with a proposed_label, when the evidence is gradient-led or otherwise does not fit. Recurring proposed labels are evidence for new categories.

displayLabels.description: The former eight-way primaries, kept as display names derived from the two axes and the Vibrant tag. They name a pair for people; they are not the classification. An Image-Led direction has the display label Image-Led.

labels.label: Neutral
labels.definition: Neutral colors define the pair. A chromatic accent may be present but does not define it.

labels.label: Colorful / Multicolor
labels.definition: Several distinct chromatic colors play substantial roles.

labels.label: Two-Tone
labels.definition: Both colors in the defining pair are chromatic and come from different hue families.

labels.label: Monochromatic Foundation
labels.definition: One hue family defines the pair, with variation mainly in lightness and chroma.

labels.label: Light + Vibrant
labels.definition: A light ground with a vibrant chromatic color.
labels.derivation: Light foundation, Chromatic structure, and the pair's chromatic color is vibrant.

labels.label: Dark + Vibrant
labels.definition: A dark ground with a vibrant chromatic color.
labels.derivation: Dark foundation, Chromatic structure, and the pair's chromatic color is vibrant.

labels.label: Light + Muted
labels.definition: A light ground with a muted, pastel or otherwise subdued chromatic color.
labels.derivation: Light foundation, Chromatic structure, and the pair's chromatic color is not vibrant.

labels.label: Dark + Muted
labels.definition: A dark ground with a muted or otherwise subdued chromatic color.
labels.derivation: Dark foundation, Chromatic structure, and the pair's chromatic color is not vibrant.
